GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd on rail (2L from lead) early . Tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed to quicken @ 400m. Pushed along Two Wide (1.5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 200m & kept finding in last 100m until got up on line. # Had last crack.

Slow Out 1 length but Quickly Improved 2 Lengths 3rd. Under Good Hold tracking Leader to Turn . off its heels into Straight looming, 2 Horse War last 200m but Leader dug in. this Battled On Well closing, Leader denied it ( ex-L.Bridge ) # good/leader lasted

Jumped Ok box seated 3rd 2l. had good run behind them. niggled at chasing 400m and Under Pressure Turn . Straightened Up Hard Ridden on rail but no Clear air Inside horses and onepaced to line. vet = nil # Inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping brushed another rnr. Raced keenly in the early stages. When questioned, rdr std at the mare’s previous 2 starts she was forced to settle back from wide barriers, however today from an inside barrier she was in a handy position behind the leaders. She added while she wasn’t afforded completely clear running in the straight, her mnt was not travelling well enough to take advantage of available runs and, in her view, was disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr rep subsequently reported the mare had done well since its disappointing performance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length and Restrained early. Settled Down 3rd last 12l. pushed off rail from 600m and Ridden Along to Turn . Straightened Up too far back before Ran On Strongly and Made Good Ground Without threatening # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: slow out x 1.5 Lengths . Settled Down 9th on rail 8 Lengths @ 850m. Just Inside winner back there. Two Wide Straightening Up next to last.found Clear final 275, hit line well # good once Clear
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and from a wide barrier was then shifted behind runners in the early stages. Held up for clear running from the 450m until the 250m. Near the 50m shifted in and became awkwardly placed at the heels of another runner.
